name: Quetiapine ER
summary: Quetiapine ER (Seroquel XR) is a once-daily, extended-release antipsychotic used for schizophrenia, bipolar mania and depression, and as an add-on for major depression.
description: Quetiapine ER, sold as Seroquel XR, is a newer (atypical) antipsychotic that works mainly by blocking dopamine D2 and serotonin 5-HT2A receptors, among other targets. The extended-release form lets you take it once a day and keeps the medicine level in your blood steady over 24 hours. It is approved for schizophrenia, bipolar mania and bipolar depression, and as an add-on treatment for major depressive disorder.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Quetiapine ER, marketed as Seroquel XR, is an atypical antipsychotic that works primarily by antagonizing dopamine D2 and serotonin 5-HT2A receptors, among other targets. The extended-release formulation allows for once-daily dosing, maintaining therapeutic plasma levels over 24 hours. It is approved for the treatment of schizophrenia, bipolar mania and depression, and as adjunctive therapy for major depressive disorder.
